column1: # agent-system 2.0 install manifest (SPEC-2.0.md § B8): the machinery table, machine-read.
# One row per artifact under a machinery directory: path (repo-relative), kind, destination.
# install/install.sh fails when a file under a machinery directory has no row here, or when any
# symbolic link sits under one. Exactly one ledger-schema row (ledger/schema.sql, the file the
# module applies), one ledger-init row, one ledger-backup row and one ledger-backup-agent row.
# destination: "-" = used in place from the checkout, nothing is copied or linked;
#              only, never loaded by the installer.
# Columns are separated by one TAB. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Linux (later addition, not built): a systemd user timer running the ledger-backup row, e.g.
# {systemd_user}/<name>. Until it exists, off macOS the open-time copy is the only schedule.
